name: Burning
description: Target burns for additional damage over 4 seconds.

name: Chilled
description: Instant damage. Applies Minor Maim for 4 seconds, reducing target’s damage done. Also applies Minor Brittle increasing the critical damage done to the target. Note that a frost staff has to be on your active bar when Chilled is applied to proc Minor Brittle.

name: Concussion
description: Instant damage and adds extra damage if target was recently Concussed. Applies Minor Vulnerability for 4 seconds, increasing their damage taken.

name: Diseased
description: Instant damage, Also deals additional damage in a 6 meter radius around the target. Applies Minor Defile for 4 seconds, decreasing healing taken and health recovery.

name: Hemorrhaging
description: Target bleeds over 4 seconds, stacks up to 3 times and increases damage per stack by 25%.

name: Overcharged
description: Instant damage. Instantly restores 65 Magicka to its activator. Applies Minor Magickasteal for 4 seconds, causing attackers to restore Magicka.

name: Poisoned
description: Deals Poison Damage over 4 seconds. Is considered execute damage. Deals 100% bonus damage to targets under 100% health.

name: Sundered
description: Instant damage and grants you 100 Weapon and Spell Damage for 4 seconds.
